Name: More-ay 67 Eels
Author: StarandVeil
Description:
[size=3][b][u]Description[/u][/b][/size]
[size=3]More-ay 67 Eels adds 12 new eels to Stardew Valley. Each variant has two eels in the shape of 6 and 7. Variants: Glacier, Gold, Lava, Magma, Nautical, and Slimy. The eels have their own locations and fish pod items. (Please note: There are no moray eels in this mod.)[/size]

[size=3][b][u]How to Catch[/u][/b][/size]
[spoiler][size=3](All Eel are available year round and all day)
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]The Glacier Eels- Found at the Mines on Level 60. Fishing level required: 5[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]The Gold Eels - Found at Ginger Island when it is sunny. Fishing level required: 5.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]The Magma Eels - Found at the Volcano Caldera on Floor 10. Fishing level required: 5[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]The Nautical Eels - Found at the Beach when it is raining. Fishing level required: 0[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]The Slimy Eels - The Slimy 6 Eel can be found in the Cindersap Forest's lake and Mountain's lake. The Slimy 7 Eel can be in the Cindersap Forest river and the Town's river. Fishing level required: 2[/size][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
